test_case.test_name: H.264 parser/reorder hardware decode integrity and physical display
test_case.purpose: Validate an approved H.264 access-unit stream is parsed and hardware-decoded on the bound GPU with correct reference/B-frame display ordering and is physically displayed without visual defects, independently from H.264 encoding.
required_package: Immutable H.264 input and SHA-256 with container/Annex-B, profile/level, SPS/PPS, bit depth/chroma, scan/MBAFF, dimensions, rate/time base, reference/B-frame structure and expected frame count
Golden display-order `framemd5`, expected PTS/DTS mapping and pinned output pixel/deinterlace policy
Exact GPU serial/UUID/BDF, driver/VBIOS and ffmpeg/ffprobe build with approved H.264 NVDEC capability and verbose no-fallback evidence
Bounded scratch/evidence root; approved connector/display/mode/player/capture route and qualified operator
Health/event thresholds, abort criteria and recovery
test_case.test_command: PARAMETERIZED REVIEW-LAYER PROCEDURE — do not execute until approved. Verify H.264 input/golden hashes, capacity, exact device capability and baseline without clearing logs. Record `ffprobe -v error -show_streams -show_format -show_frames -select_streams v:0 -of json "$H264_INPUT"`; require approved H.264 profile/level, parameter sets, scan, dimensions/rates, frame types and PTS/DTS/display-order expectations. Record ffmpeg build/hardware capability. Run `ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel repeat+level+verbose -hwaccel "$APPROVED_HWACCEL" -hwaccel_device "$GPU_SELECTOR" -i "$H264_INPUT" -map 0:v:0 -an -vf "$APPROVED_HW_DOWNLOAD_PIXEL_FORMAT_AND_DEINTERLACE_POLICY" -f framemd5 "$H264_ACTUAL_FRAMEMD5"`; require bound NVDEC/no fallback and exact golden/display-order/timestamp equality. Play the same complete input on the approved connector and collect time-correlated visual evidence and final health/events. Stop on anomaly; do not retry.
test_case.expected_result: Hashes and H.264 profile/level/SPS/PPS/scan/reference/reorder metadata match; the exact GPU selects the approved hardware decoder without fallback; all display-order frames, PTS and signatures match the golden manifest and ffmpeg exits 0 without parser/decode error. Full physical playback has no corruption, wrong reorder/judder, unapproved combing, freeze, tearing, crop/aspect/color or edge artifact; health remains acceptable and evidence is decode-only.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires all H.264 metadata/parser/reorder, hardware, frame-signature, health and qualified visual checks. FAIL on encode-row evidence substitution, fallback, unsupported required profile, SPS/PPS/parser error, wrong input/GPU, PTS/DTS/display-order/frame/signature mismatch, truncated playback, visual defect, nonzero exit or health breach. BLOCKED at runtime when bindings are absent. End user owns verdict.

Verify immutable media/golden and SPS/PPS/profile/reorder contract before workload; uniquely tag decode evidence.

Stop on media/parser/decoder/GPU/thermal/storage/display/evidence anomaly; no retry, reset, reboot, log clear or firmware change.
expected_evidence: Exact GPU/driver/VBIOS/ffmpeg identity, positive H.264 capability, selected NVDEC path and no-fallback log
Complete parser/decode log, exit status, display-order frame/timestamp accounting and exact `framemd5` comparison
Connector/display/mode/player identity and full-clip time-correlated visual record
Decode-only Source Key/Variant tags, encode non-reuse audit, scratch/health/events, no-retry audit and verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop decoder/player on first parser, integrity, visual or health failure; preserve decode-only media, manifests, logs, captures and events and do not retry. Remove only approved scratch after retention; restore approved display/session state without reset, reboot or firmware action and escalate if health remains abnormal.
